_: Real fighters the source snapshot gets wrong, by id. 'born' (YYYY-MM-DD) sets the birth date: the age and the birthday follow. 'gym' moves the fighter to the gym they really train at; a save made before moves them only if they're still at a 'from' gym (one id or a list), or wherever the world put them when 'from' is left out (the source gave them no gym). Read by scripts/build-data.mjs and world/create.ts repair() for saves made before. 'fam': true means the name is written family name first, as the UFC writes its Chinese fighters (Song Yadong, Zhang Weili): the full name keeps that order and the short name is the family name (Song, Zhang); world/real.ts and repair() read it.
